opportunities.title: Small Grants – UK September round
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that can receive grant funds; individuals not accepted.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for UK-Japan collaborative projects across arts, culture, humanities, science, youth, education, sport, and other fields.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year, up to £30,000 total

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should have an existing research record or be health professionals, and must involve UK-Japan collaboration; early‑career applicants welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Annual awards supporting exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, covering travel, conference and publication costs.
